executives.subtitle: Leadership
executives.title: Executive Team
executives.description: Guided by Islamic principles of Amanah (trust) and Ihsan (excellence), our leadership team stewards AfriNuts with integrity and vision.

ceo.title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: With over 15 years in agribusiness leadership, Hamza founded AfriNuts on principles of ethical trade and sustainable growth. He oversees strategic vision and ensures all operations align with Islamic fiduciary principles.

cfo.title: Chief Financial & Operating Officer
bio: Sekou manages financial stewardship with Sharia-compliant practices, overseeing profit distribution (Mudarabah) and ensuring transparent resource management.

cco.title: Chief Commercial Officer
bio: Mohamadue leads international business development with a focus on riba-free contracts and ethical marketing practices per Sunnah.

ops.title: Operations Manager
ops.alt: Rouillard Cedric, Operations Manager of AfriNuts
bio: Rouillard ensures excellence in daily operations, implementing processing timelines and quality standards with ihsan (excellence).

admin.title: Administrative Support Manager
admin.alt: Mohammed Beniken, Admin Manager of AfriNuts
bio: Mohammed upholds the Prophetic directive to 'pay the worker before his sweat dries' through fair HR practices and data security.

farm.title: Farm Manager
farm.alt: Souleymane Sangare, Farm Manager of AfriNuts
bio: Souleymane implements Sunna-inspired planting cycles and serves as the bridge between AfriNuts and local farming communities.
